steps.name: Missing CustomerID removal
steps.description: Records without an identified customer cannot be attributed to a customer profile.

steps.name: Cancelled transactions removal
steps.description: Cancelled orders (invoices prefixed with 'C') represent reversals and returns.

steps.name: Non-positive Quantity or UnitPrice removal
steps.description: Non-positive price or quantity is excluded; the reason for these entries is not inferred.

steps.name: Exact duplicate records removal
steps.description: Identical rows across all original columns are removed; their origin is unknown.

profiles.name: High-Value Champions
profiles.description: Customers who shop frequently, purchased recently, and generate substantially higher revenue than average.
characteristics: High purchase frequency of 10 orders (population median: 2)
Strong recency (8 days since last transaction)
profiles.business_insight: Prioritize VIP loyalty recognition, early product previews, and premium customer service to maintain high retention.

profiles.name: At-Risk Valuable Shoppers
profiles.description: Shoppers who previously generated notable revenue or orders but haven't made a purchase in a prolonged period.
characteristics: Demonstrated willingness to place multiple orders (4 orders)
profiles.business_insight: Win-back email campaigns with personalized incentives could reactivate interest before permanent attrition occurs.

profiles.name: Active Regular Shoppers
profiles.description: Engaged, regular shoppers who order consistently but maintain moderate order values per transaction.
profiles.business_insight: Cross-selling related basket items or offering volume discounts may encourage higher average order values.

profiles.name: Dormant Low-Engagement Shoppers
profiles.description: Infrequent shoppers with long periods of inactivity and low cumulative monetary spend.
characteristics: Protracted inactivity (177 days since last order)
Single or very few purchases (1 orders)
profiles.business_insight: Evaluate cost-effective automated re-engagement or reserve marketing budget for higher-converting segments.

metrics.selection_reason: K=4 is a descriptive granularity choice after inspecting K=2..8. K=2 has the highest log-space silhouette; four clusters retain useful RFM detail with balanced groups. The elbow is gradual, and no uniquely optimal K is claimed.

experiment_a_raw.name: Experiment A: Raw RFM with Standard Scaling
experiment_a_raw.description: StandardScaler applied directly to raw RFM values without log transformation.
experiment_a_raw.finding: Raw scaling gives high silhouette values but concentrates small groups of extreme buyers. These groups may be valid outliers, but offer limited detail for typical customers.

experiment_b_log.name: Experiment B: Log-Transformed RFM with Standard Scaling
experiment_b_log.description: log1p applied to RFM features prior to StandardScaler, handling heavy right-tailed skewness.
experiment_b_log.finding: Log scaling compresses large values and produces more balanced descriptive groups. This is a change of geometry, not proof of higher accuracy or temporal stability.
